description: This file defines a utility class for logging, providing static methods to log messages at various priority levels. It acts as a wrapper to Android's native Log class, enabling custom logging chains via LogNode. The class includes methods for verbose, debug, info, warn, error, and assert log levels, and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for logging at different levels and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log messages to the current LogNode, with overloads for including exceptions.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with overloads for Throwable and message only.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with overloads for Throwable and message only.
